newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Jackin issues 90.75 mln shrs at HK$1.05 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's Jackin issues 90.75 mln shrs at HK$1.05 each.

text.p: Jackin International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was offering 90.75 million shares, comprising 74.25 million new shares and 16.5 million existing shares, at HK$1.05 per share in an initial public offering in Hong Kong.
The new shares represent 22.5 percent of the group's enlarged share capital and the existing shares represent 5.0 percent, it said.
The prospective weighted average and fully diluted price/earning multiple are 5.0 times and 6.0 times, respectively, it added.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd will be the sponsor of the new issue and offer, it said.

The company said total net proceeds would amount to HK$62 million of which more than HK$30 million would be used to buy and install mastering equipment, HK$20 million would be used to buy and install machinery and equipment for compact disc production and the balance used for working capital.
Jackin engages in the manufacture, replication and sale of content-based and blank information storage media products including CD-ROMs, VCDs, CDs and CD cleaners, and floppy disks.
Jackin posted a profit of HK$25 million for the year ended December 31, 1995. Turnover rose to HK$333.6 million in 1995.
The company said it had a profit of HK$27 million for the first five months of 1996.
The group's overall profit margin increased to 15 percent in the first five months of this year from 7.5 percent for the 1995 fiscal year, it said.
The company forecast combined profit after taxation and minority interest before extraordinary items for the year ending December 31, 1996, would not be less than HK$55 million.
The public offer will begin from November 15-20. Trading in the shares is expected to begin on November 28.
